exposure: performance of an ultrasound examination during labor
waiting time at the delivery facility before receiving the first examination
time needed to reach the delivery facility
means of transportation used to reach the delivery facility
cohort: 568 asphyxial neonates admitted to the National Reference Center for Neonatology and Nutrition at the Children's Hospital of Rabat, University Hospital Center
finding: The study found relationships between degrees of perinatal asphyxia and the distance traveled to get to the delivery structure, the time needed to reach the delivery facility, the means of transportation used to reach the delivery facility, the waiting time at the delivery facility before receiving the first examination, the performance of an ultrasound examination during labor, the labor time, the instruments used during delivery and the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The study found a relationship between the mode of delivery and the severity of perinatal asphyxia.
